modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of long generic or brand drug names, where the rest of the name is still to come.

modes.label: Inside CYP enzyme names
modes.description: Pieces of CYP enzyme labels like CYP3A4 or cytochrome P450 in interaction passages.

modes.label: Other linking spots
modes.description: Occasional non-drug words such as 'such as' or the start of 'viscous'.
